title: The Throat Row and the Palate Row
label: ch:two-rows-runway
canDo: I can write seven more consonants and say, for any of them, whether the voice is on and whether the breath is released.

payoff.summary: Say both four-step rows in order from the two switches that generate them, with no model on the page.
payoff.note: The payoff adds no sign. It asks for the PATTERN that produces the row, so a reader who holds the rule can rebuild any letter they drop.
